scope: Independent visual review of all 49 existing five-frame native-index cut neighborhoods only. Whole-film material review, continuous paced playback, audio hearing and final artifact approval remain separate.
indexConvention: Zero-based native presentation index; 30000/1001 fps; frame n starts at n*1001/30000 seconds.
acceptedAdaptation: The approved Grifon copy, charcoal/gold/cream palette, Inter contours and truthful disclosed product captures. Existing V2 accepted residuals do not imply exact source pixels, hue, typography or blend strength.
